extraction.Name: Sie An Bordeaux formerly Susan Butler
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent was recorded in Todd County Records by the Tri-County Abstract Company on November 5, 1923 and in the Tripp County Records by the Todd County State Bank on May 29, 1920
extraction.Buyer: Conveyed by deed on October 13, 1923 to Carl H. Diez for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; later quit claimed by Susan Bordeaux, formerly Susan Butler, deed dated October 13, 1923 to Carl H. Diez for $5200.00
extraction.NOTES: Land includes northeast quarter of section 8, and northwest quarter of section 9, township 96, range 79, and southeast quarter of the northeast quarter of section 25, township 37, range 25. Deeds signed by Susan Bordeaux and Samuel Bordeaux. A quit claim deed signed by Susan Bordeaux, formerly Susan Butler, was also executed in favor of Carl H. Diez. Document dated June 1929.
